Name: Vegan Bundles Updated to 1.6
Author: treesandstuff
Description:
All credit to the original modder :) I just reformatted things!

Tested in Vanilla with Content Patcher and CJB Cheats (to make testing easier).

Tested with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/collections/tckf0m]Stardew Valley VERY Expanded[/url] and it worked fine in 1.6.5 on a new save!


All credit goes to the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4928]original mod!!!
[/url]



It seems the mod only works in new saves, so if your bundles have already been updated with the vanilla ones (or whatever other bundles you may be using), the vegan ones won't show up. There's probably a way to edit the save file and either reset the community center or regenerate the bundles and somehow refresh them, but I haven't looked into that.
